assertions.name: covariance_epic_M1_free_cumulant_reframing
assertions.source: Sum c^2 = R4/3+R2^2/2-R2/6 exact (n<=12); Var(R4)=9|C3|, Var(R3)=4C(n,2), Cov(R3,R4)=Cov(Sum h,R3)=0, M_1=(1/3)Cov(Sum h,R4) exact (n<=15). Structural reframing, not a proof; sign of Cov(Sum h,R4) open. No fit; no c_k.

description: The first odd moment M_1 in Kerov's free-cumulant basis (qou-x631, qou-ogrk): cleanest structural reframing, NOT a resolution. From the transition-measure free cumulants R_k (R_2=n exactly): Σ_□ c² = R_4/3 + R_2²/2 − R_2/6 exactly (n≤12), so ω₃=(R_4+R_2)/3 and M_1 = Cov_Planch(Σh,Σc²) = (1/3)Cov(Σh,R_4). Exact second-order structure (n≤15): Var(R_4)=3n(n−1)(n−2)=9|C₃|, Var(R_3)=4C(n,2)=2n(n−1), and the exact orthogonalities Cov(R_3,R_4)=0, Cov(Σh,R_3)=0. So M_1>0 ⟺ Cov(Σh,R_4)>0 (hook-sum vs the 4th free cumulant). WALL: R_4=3Σc²−3n²/2+n/2 is affine in Σc² so the R_4 form is circular, and Σh∉A is not poly(R)+γ(ℓ+λ₁) — its non-A structure is genuinely complex; the sign of Cov(Σh,R_4) remains OPEN (needs Σh's Plancherel-cov projection onto A, a free-probability/Kerov-CLT computation with finite-n error bound, beyond exact enumeration). Cleanest reframing to date; the exact variances and orthogonalities are new. Does NOT prove M_1, odd positivity, A2, or the kernel. scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 unchanged.

data.open: sign of Cov(Sum h, R4) = M_1>0 still open; Sum h not in A, not poly(R)+g(ell+lam1)
